lines: #A budget isn't telling you what you *can't* do.
It's telling your money where to *go.*
And at the end of the month you're asking the same question.
This much for bills. This much for *savings.*
This much for the things you *love*, guilt-free.
A good budget has room for *joy.*
It's not about never spending. It's about spending on *purpose.*
Sit down for ten minutes at the start of each *month.*
Write the plan. Then let the plan do the *worrying* for you.
And watch how much *freedom* you suddenly have.
end: Save this and plan next month tonight.

post.title: You Hate Budgets? You've Got It Backwards.
post.caption: A budget isn't a prison. It's telling your money where to go. 💰
